title: IMAGEDEF auxiliary status-key capture bound
mode: Local implementation slice with generated fast validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound the adapter-owned invalid IMAGEDEF generation and conflicting-key status sets together.
Deduplicate repeated status callbacks without consuming additional status-key budget.
Make status-key exhaustion sticky for IMAGEDEF and typed-entity capture and refuse DXF publication.

implementation.behavior: The logical count includes actual set sizes and the adapter-maintained lifetime counter. Exhaustion makes IMAGEDEF and typed-entity capture fail closed; this does not prevent caller mutation of public containers after callbacks.

limitations: This bounds only the adapter-owned IMAGEDEF status-index sets and propagates exhaustion to existing fail-closed capture preflight. It does not establish full callback-state immutability, external format behavior, serializer completeness, independent ACIS semantics, or native consumer qualification. Work remains uncommitted over the user's existing large working-tree changes.
